text: dsh-drop-to-path（DSH Web 插件）：把拖放或粘贴的图片与文件转成工作区路径，供纯文本模型使用。图片保留原生附件预览，发送时上传并转成路径；PDF、Office、文本、压缩包、视频和音频显示为可移除标签，发送时附加路径。文件保存到工作区 .drops/。适合希望在 DSH Web 中向文本模型发送截图或文件的用户；无需额外密钥或账号。

dsh-drop-to-path is a DSH Web plugin that converts pasted or dropped images and files into workspace paths for text-only models. Images retain native previews; other files appear as removable tiles. On send, uploads go to workspace .drops/ and paths join the message. No key or account needed.
想把截图直接粘贴到 DSH，让纯文本模型收到文件路径。
我想把 PDF 拖进 DSH 对话里并让它变成工作区路径。
DSH 能不能把 Office 文档作为路径发送，而不是附件？
拖入图片后保留预览，发送时自动转成路径。
想在 DSH 里粘贴音频或视频文件并附上它的本地路径。
让 DSH 的附件栏显示可移除的文件标签，发送时自动附加路径。
I want to paste a screenshot into DSH and send its workspace path to a text-only model.
Can I drop PDFs and spreadsheets into the DSH composer as workspace paths?
Keep image previews in the attachment rail but convert images to paths when I send.
I need to paste or drag media files into DSH and attach their paths to my message.
dsh-drop-to-path 的功能「图片转路径」：发送带图片的消息时，将图片上传到工作区并以文本路径发送。
dsh-drop-to-path 的功能「导入非图片文件」：粘贴或拖入支持的文件后，按顺序上传并在附件栏显示可移除标签。
dsh-drop-to-path 的功能「路径随消息发送」：点击发送时合并文件路径和用户文字；发送成功后清空文件队列。
dsh-drop-to-path 的功能「支持文件格式」：导入路由按图片 30 MB、其他文件 100 MB 的上限接收白名单扩展名。
dsh-drop-to-path 的功能「上传失败提示」：失败时显示页面提示；图片上传失败会退回原生附件发送流程。
dsh-drop-to-path 使用前须知：导入文件保存在工作区 .drops/ 目录；发送成功后附件队列清空，目录中的文件仍需自行清理。

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Demo：*Drag images / PPT / TXT / ZIP into the composer → square file chips appear next to image thumbnails → hit send → the model receives workspace file paths.*

*The effect: images and files arrive at the text-only model as workspace paths, ready for vision / document tools.*

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Why this plugin：```
Model "deepseek-v4-flash" does not support image input.
```

[dsh-vision-toolkit](https://github.com/Anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit) solves the "see the image" half — but its tools only accept **workspace file paths**, so the image must enter the message as a path. Every screenshot became: save to workspace → manually type the path into the message. Painful. And beyond images, DSH refuses to attach PDFs, office documents, videos or any non-image file at all.

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Why this plugin：After experiencing "paste and go" in another tool, I decided to bring that experience back to DSH: **keep the attachment UI completely native, and convert images *and* files to paths only at the moment of sending**. Hence this plugin.

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · How it works：- The image admission preflight (`attachment-error` in `dsh-host-apiproxy`) is **bypassed**: no image block is ever sent, the model only sees text.
- Nothing is typed into the composer while you add files — paths are appended **on send**, exactly like the image conversion.
- Upload failure is never silent: a visible notice explains what happened before falling back to the native send path; messages are never swallowed.
- Supports paste and drag-and-drop; images, files and mixed batches are uploaded in order and sent as one text block of paths.

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Supported file types：| Type | Extensions | Limit | Experience |
|---|---|---|---|
| Images | `png` `jpg` `jpeg` `webp` `gif` | 30MB | Native attachment card (preview / remove), auto-converted to paths on send |
| Documents | `pdf` `doc` `docx` `xls` `xlsx` `ppt` `pptx` `txt` `md` `csv` `json` | 100MB | Square chip in the attachment rail (format icon, full name on hover, ✕ to remove), path appended on send |
| Archives | `zip` | 100MB | Same |
| Video | `mp4` `mov` `webm` `mkv` `avi` | 100MB | Same |
| Audio | `mp3` `wav` `flac` `m4a` | 100MB | Same |

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Supported file types：> Images keep the native attachment experience. DSH itself only accepts these image formats as attachments (see the toast below) and refuses everything else — this plugin turns the rest into plain workspace paths instead, so the agent can process them with PDF / document tools.

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Pairing with dsh-vision-toolkit (recommended)：| Scenario | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Image Q&A | screenshot → save to workspace → type path | screenshot → Ctrl+V → Enter |
| Multi-image diff (pixel diff) | same, type every path | just send two images |
| Long-screenshot OCR / UI restoration | same | just send the image |
| Analyze a PDF / xlsx / video | copy it into the workspace, type the path | just drag it in and send |

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Comparison with similar plugins：- [dsh-drag-and-drop](https://github.com/bill9109/dsh-drag-and-drop): dropping a file inserts its **raw path** into the composer, no file copying. Great for referencing files already in the workspace; images are still sent as attachments (still rejected by text-only models), and paste is not supported.
- **This plugin**: keeps the native attachment UI (preview / remove), **automatically copies images and files to the workspace and converts them to paths on send**, supports paste and drag-and-drop, and shows non-image files as removable square chips in the attachment rail. Built for "sending images and files to a text-only model".
@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Comparison with similar plugins：They are complementary: use dsh-drag-and-drop to reference existing files, use this plugin to send screenshots and new files.

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Installation：Requirements: DeepSeek Harness (Web profile), Node.js, `dsh` CLI.

```sh
@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Option 1: install via dsh plugin (recommended)：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-drop-to-path

@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · 3. copy the directory (including lib/) into profiles/<name>/node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path：```

**Restart the Web profile** after installing (relaunch the launcher / restart `dsh web`). No settings to configure.
@dsh-external/dsh-drop-to-path README · Usage：Files are stored under `<workspace>/.drops/`; clean them up whenever you like.

This plugin depends on several **undocumented internal interfaces** of DSH (service names, method signatures, storage formats) and may break after a DSH upgrade. Read [`ADAPTING.md`](ADAPTING.md) before upgrading — it contains the failure symptoms and the fix steps.

- Plugin broken after a DSH upgrade: follow the symptom table in [`ADAPTING.md`](ADAPTING.md), fix, and append a row to the adaptation log.
